{"m": "gpt-4o", "msg": [{"content": "You compare short personal anecdotes by their underlying relational structure - the pattern of intentions, causes, deceptions, reversals, and outcomes among the people involved - NOT by their surface topic, setting, or vocabulary. Two stories can be about totally different situations yet share the same deep structure; two stories can share the same topic yet have opposite structure.", "role": "system"}, {"content": "SITUATION:
My sister applied for the same job I wanted at my company. I was more qualified, but I withdrew my application without telling her. She got the job. She still thinks she beat me fair and square, and I'll never tell her otherwise.

CANDIDATE A:
My father secretly paid off my college loans without telling me. For years I thought I'd managed to pay them off through my own budgeting discipline. I only found out when he passed and I saw the bank records. He never once mentioned it or took credit.

CANDIDATE B:
My sister and I both applied for the same job at my company. I was more qualified and got the position. She was disappointed but understood the outcome. We talked about it afterward, and I helped her find a similar role at another firm.

Which candidate shares the same underlying relational structure as the SITUATION (ignore surface topic similarity)? Respond as JSON: {"choice": "A" or "B", "reason": "<one sentence>"}.", "role": "user"}], "t": 0.0, "tag": "exp2:3"}
content: {"choice": "A", "reason": "Both involve a secret action taken by one party that benefits the other, who remains unaware of the truth and believes they achieved the outcome on their own."}
